summary:
The cited maintained nonpackable example composes published SDD.Artifacts workspace lifecycle/work-model/catalog/provenance readers with Coordination.Core OrdinaryAssignment.AuthoritativeObligations. Its small parameters are in-memory call inputs, not another serialized workspace protocol. The compiler receives externally accepted model bytes/fingerprint and module mapping, caller-supplied original requirements and observation time, physical repository/components, raw source bytes and independently selected expected work keys. It checks accepted-module coverage, raw source hashes, regeneration correspondence and complete original facts. It returns typed source obligations; it does not execute declared checks or allocate resources, and productionProjection refuses.

A genuine caller must bind the selected implementation/build/test integration files, not merely authored specifications. In the cited cohort, independent review found four test-project files and the solution missing from the first caller closure. The repair uses actual component roots and safe standalone solution metadata; a later exact project-census integration also binds the plan and architecture control source. Each selected omission refuses, byte mutation changes raw hash and authority digest, and restoration recovers the original digest. A component rooted at dot remains refused. An independent expected population cannot be derived from the compiler's own output.

Accepted-profile changes are proposals against the actual accepted lifecycle base, followed by a real accountable acceptance and reduction; regenerating a hash alone cannot replace that decision. Source custody labels distinguish new local bytes from files committed at an older base. Original attempt facts and clocks remain caller obligations. The isolated reference/test graphs use project-local published Artifacts overrides without upgrading the production-wide pin or importing Host. Local/synthetic controls and a retained genuine invocation establish only their cited source behavior; they do not establish hosted qualification, protected delivery, installed capabilities, physical containment, publication, consumer adoption or whole-parent acceptance.
title: Workspace source composition requires independent acceptance, complete population and real input closure
